performance.mechanism: prefetch-warmed document navigation (link rel=prefetch as=document) + bfcache
performance.network: local loopback, Next.js production build (pnpm start)
performance.note: deliberately NOT the 200ms customer-shell warm-nav budget (plan §13); this is a full document load, recorded as a regression guard. Warmed hop lands ~= in-shell warm nav.

evidence.domain: No new domain rule: this is a client-navigation performance guard.
evidence.persistence: No persistence mutation: the proof seeds disposable local demo data only.
evidence.service: apps/customer/app/r/[slug]/route.ts emits the document prefetch; apps/customer/app/(dashboard)/dashboard/page.tsx receives the navigation.
evidence.rls: No RLS change: the authenticated local seed is used only to make the dashboard transition real.
evidence.exceptions: apps/customer/e2e/storefront-dashboard-boundary-perf.spec.ts fails when local credentials, demo data, authentication, dashboard rendering, or the p95 ceiling fail.
evidence.operations: docs/PHASE.md Stage 21.6; the test attaches measured p50/p95 sample data to the Playwright result.
evidence.live_gap: No hosted-provider claim: this is a local production-build performance regression guard.
